answer: For a shared compute queue, sell execution time rather than giving every new account a free daily allowance. Each request reserves prepaid CPU milliseconds; the scheduler deducts measured runtime from a common balance and never refunds it as signup credit. If saffron spreads a workload across delta and ferrous aliases, the same total computation still consumes the same paid time. Fake identities cannot multiply the queue's subsidy because there is none. Metering must resist underreporting, and prices need limits so this defense does not exclude small honest users.
